discipline.rationale: 4-phase task pattern observed (pending -> per_task_active -> quality_active -> per_task_approved) on all three tasks per state-transitions.log T0-T3. T0.2 revision cycle (T4 -> T2 -> T3) followed the documented cycle-counter loop within the 4/4 cap (1/4 used). Scope-of-target-files adherence honored: each task wrote only to its declared target paths (T0.1 read-only; T0.2 wrote inventory-baseline.txt; T0.3 read-only directory check).

scope_deviations.rationale: One MINOR scope_deviation captured on T0.3 (per-task result file leaked to wrong feature-slug directory). Per ADR-0033, the deviation was surfaced by the task quality handler with informational severity and recorded in the per-task result. Does not block phase advance per Contract 2 rollup rule (no blocking or revisable findings; informational only).

findings.rule: ADR-0033 / ADR-0029 — No silent scope changes (execution extension)
findings.divergence: T0.3 result artifact written to a sister feature-slug directory rather than pipeline-design-time-discipline-r1/. Deviation surfaced by task quality handler at APPROVED time (non-blocking).
findings.next_action: Informational only; no remediation required at phase close. Carry forward as a note in the deliverable archive evidence trail. Operator may relocate the leaked artifact during finalize-packager if desired.

rollup_rule_applied: Contract 2: PASS = no blocking and no revisable findings in any dimension. One informational scope_deviation (MINOR, non-blocking, non-revisable) does not gate advancement.
